principles.text: Everything clickable looks clickable: a pointer cursor, and a visible difference from plain text.
One art direction, held on every page. No page borrows another style.
The header, the navigation and the buttons are the same on every page: same place, same look, same order.
Nothing generic: no purple-to-blue gradient, no shadowed cards everywhere, no decorative emoji, no layout that could be any SaaS template.
A clear hierarchy, with one focal point per page. The eye knows where to start.
Elements line up on a grid. Edges, gutters and baselines agree.
Density is controlled: nothing cramped, nothing lost in empty space.
Empty, error and loading states exist and say what is happening and what to do next. A blank area is a failure.

reasons: The nav links are underlined in white and the pink pill "Découvrir" button stands out clearly from the body text.
The nav links are white and underlined and the pink filled 'Découvrir' pill stands clearly apart from the body text.

A purple gradient header, rounded comic-style font, cream background and pink pill button share nothing with the dark-bar serif table of /produits, the yellow-and-red banner of /commandes or the dark monospace look of /contact.
This page uses a purple gradient header, a rounded comic-style font and a cream background, a style no other page shares.

A rounded comic-style font, purple gradient banner and pink pill on cream share nothing with the serif table of /produits, the yellow-and-red banner of /commandes or the dark monospace look of /contact.
The header is a tall centered gradient block with five links (Accueil, Produits, Commandes, Contact, Aide), unlike every other page's header and nav.
The centered "✨ Super Boutique ✨" title with five centered links (Accueil to Aide) appears on no other page, which each have a different header and nav.
This page has a tall centered gradient header with five links (Accueil, Produits, Commandes, Contact, Aide), while every other page shows a different header, different links and a different order.
A purple-to-blue gradient header, sparkle, rocket and party emoji, and three shadowed cards with one-line taglines make up a stock template landing.
It has a purple-to-blue gradient header, decorative emoji everywhere (✨ 🚀 🎉 ⚡ 💎 🔒) and a stock hero plus three shadowed feature cards.
It shows a purple-to-blue gradient header, three shadowed rounded cards and decorative emoji (sparkles, rockets, lightning, gem, padlock, party popper).
The emoji-framed Super Boutique title in the header and the emoji-framed hero heading are both large and centered, competing with the pink Découvrir button for first glance.
The oversized white brand on the saturated gradient band competes with the emoji-framed hero title and the hot-pink button for the first look.
The 'Super Boutique' title in the gradient banner is larger and louder than the page heading, and the pink button and three shadowed cards compete with it for the first look.
At 390 the page renders 444px wide because the nav overflows past the header's right edge, so the header band and the content no longer share edges.
At 390px the nav row runs past the header edge, with "Aide" clipped off-screen and the page wider than the viewport.
At 390px the nav overflows the header, with 'Aide' running past the gradient band and off the screen edge.
At 390 the nav links are crammed into one line that spills off screen, while the feature cards wrap four words each in large padded boxes.
At 390px the nav links are squeezed into one row that overflows the screen, and each card holds one short line inside a large padded box.
At 390px the cards shrink to a narrow column with wide empty margins on both sides, each heavily padded box holding a single three-word line.
Every area shows content (hero, button, three feature cards) and no data area is left blank.
Every area on the page shows its content, with no blank region waiting for data.
All the content shown is filled in, with no blank area waiting for data.
The Ajouter controls are visible native buttons and the nav and Voir mes commandes links are underlined, distinct from plain text.
The nav links are underlined in green, "Voir mes commandes" is a blue underlined link and "Ajouter" uses raised buttons.
The nav links are lime and underlined, 'Voir mes commandes' is a blue underlined link and the 'Ajouter' controls are visible buttons.
Browser-default serif text, a gray-bordered table and neon green text on a black bar form a style no other page uses.
A black bar with a neon green serif brand above an unstyled serif table is a style unrelated to the other pages.
A black bar with a lime uppercase serif wordmark over a plain bordered table on white matches none of the gradient home page, the yellow /commandes or the dark monospace /contact.
A thin black bar with a green uppercase SUPER BOUTIQUE and tiny lowercase links in the order contact, home, produits differs in place, look, labels and order from the other headers.
The header is a thin black bar with "SUPER BOUTIQUE" on the left and tiny lowercase "contact home produits" on the right, in a different order and look from every other page.
The header is a thin black bar with tiny lowercase 'contact home produits' on the right, a different look, set and order from the home page's centered 'Accueil, Produits, Commandes, Contact, Aide'.
The page is unstyled browser defaults: default serif, native gray buttons, a plain bordered table and a default blue link.
The content is bare browser defaults: a bordered table, grey system buttons and a default blue link.
The content is an unstyled browser-default bordered table with grey system 'Ajouter' buttons and a default blue link, with no deliberate design.
The Liste des produits heading is barely larger than the body text and the neon green brand pulls the eye, so nothing stands out as the place to start.
"Liste des produits" is barely larger than the table text and the neon green brand pulls the eye, so nothing reads as the focal point.
The small 'Liste des produits' heading is outshone by the lime wordmark, and the tiny table in the top-left corner gives the eye no clear focal point.
The "Prix" header is centered above left-aligned prices, so the decimal commas of 39,90, 89,00 and 129,00 do not line up.
The 'Produit' and 'Prix' column headers are centered while the names and prices below them are left-aligned, so the column edges do not agree.
At 1280 a 250px-wide table sits in the top-left corner with the rest of the screen empty, and the nav links are tiny and packed together.
A small table sits in the top-left corner while most of the screen is empty, and the nav links at 1280px are tiny and crowded together.
At 1280px a small, tight table sits in the top-left corner and roughly four-fifths of the screen is empty white.
The product table is filled with three products, prices and Ajouter buttons, with no blank data area.
The product table is filled with three rows, each with a price and an "Ajouter" button.
The product table is filled with three rows (Lampe, Chaise, Tapis) and no area is left blank.
Retour and Catalogue are blue underlined links, clearly different from plain text.
"Retour" and "Catalogue" are blue underlined links that look different from the heading text.
The only clickable items, 'Retour' and 'Catalogue', are blue underlined links that stand apart from the text.
A yellow banner with a red italic Boutique!!! title, a red rule and a lavender background borrow nothing from any other page's style.
A yellow banner with a red italic "Boutique!!!" over a lavender page is a style that appears on no other page.
A yellow banner with a red italic 'Boutique!!!', a red rule and a lavender background is a style found on no other page.
The header has no navigation at all; navigation moves to a left sidebar with Retour and Catalogue, labels found on no other page.
The nav here is a left sidebar with "Retour" and "Catalogue" under a yellow and red banner, which matches no other page's header or nav.
There is no top nav at all, only 'Retour' and 'Catalogue' stacked in a left sidebar under a yellow banner that renames the site 'Boutique!!!'.
No gradient, emoji or shadowed cards, and the loud yellow-and-red banner does not read as a SaaS template.
The loud yellow banner with red italic 'Boutique!!!' and the lavender page carry no gradient, shadowed cards, emoji or SaaS-template layout.
The huge red italic Boutique!!! title dominates and the Mes commandes heading has no content under it, so there is no real focal point.
The loud yellow and red "Boutique!!!" banner dominates and below "Mes commandes" there is no content to look at.
The huge red italic 'Boutique!!!' dominates and 'Mes commandes' sits below it with nothing under it, so the page has no real focal point.
The logo is indented about 42px while the sidebar sits at 10px, the sidebar links start above the heading's baseline, and at 390 the heading is pushed to the right edge beside the links.
The logo, the sidebar links and the heading start at three different left edges, and the heading's top does not align with the sidebar.
The sidebar links start at x=10, the wordmark at x=42 and the heading at x=180, and at 390px the heading is pushed to the right edge, out of line with the links.
Below the Mes commandes heading the whole lavender page is empty at both widths.
One heading and two links float in an otherwise empty lavender page at both widths.
Apart from a heading and two links, the whole lavender page is empty at both widths.
The order list under Mes commandes is blank, with no message saying there are no orders yet or pointing to the catalogue.
The area under "Mes commandes" is blank, with no message saying there are no orders yet or what to do next.
The area under 'Mes commandes' is completely blank, with no message saying there are no orders yet or what to do next.
ACCUEIL and AIDE are underlined links and ENVOYER is a solid orange button, both distinct from plain text.
"ACCUEIL" and "AIDE" are underlined, and "ENVOYER" is a solid amber block that reads as a button.
The 'ACCUEIL' and 'AIDE' links are underlined and the orange filled 'ENVOYER' bar reads clearly as a button.
A near-black background, monospace type and orange accents with a tilde-framed lowercase logo form a style found on no other page.
A dark theme with monospace type and amber accents is a style none of the other pages use.
A dark background with monospace type and orange accents on '~ super boutique ~' borrows nothing from the other pages, which each use their own style.
The dark header shows only ACCUEIL and AIDE in uppercase on the right, and at 390 the links wrap under the logo, unlike the nav on any other page.
The header shows a lowercase monospace "~ super boutique ~" with only "ACCUEIL AIDE" on the right, which differs from every other page's header and nav.
The dark grey header shows only uppercase 'ACCUEIL' and 'AIDE', with no Produits or Commandes, and a wordmark styled unlike any other page.
No gradient, emoji or shadowed cards; the monospace dark form with orange accents is not a template look.
The monospace type, the tilde-wrapped lowercase brand and the amber button give the page a specific look, with no gradient, emoji or shadowed cards.
The dark monospace look with an orange wordmark and a flat orange button has no gradient, shadowed cards, emoji or SaaS-template layout.
There is no page title saying this is a contact form; the orange logo and the orange ENVOYER button compete, and the form starts directly with an Email label.
The page has no heading saying what it is, and the amber logo and the amber "ENVOYER" button compete for attention.
There is no heading saying this is the contact page, and the orange wordmark and orange 'ENVOYER' bar compete for attention.
At 390 the labels, fields and button run flush to the screen edges with no gutter, while the logo is inset about 25px.
At 390px the labels and fields sit flush against the screen edges while the logo is inset, and at 1280px the nav baseline does not match the logo's.
At 390px the fields and button run flush against both screen edges while the wordmark is inset 25px and the nav wraps under it, and at 1280px the wordmark and nav baselines differ.
At 390 the form touches both screen edges with no margin, and at 1280 a small form floats over a mostly empty black page.
The form occupies the top third with the rest of the screen empty, and at 390px the fields touch both screen edges with no gutter.
At 390px the form is cramped against the screen edges with no gutter, and at 1280px a narrow form floats above a large empty dark area.
The page is a contact form at rest with its fields and send button shown, and no data area is left blank.
The form is fully rendered with its labels, fields and send button, and no area is left blank in place of content.
The form fields and send button are all present, with no blank area left where content should be.
